scripts.dev: concurrently -n BE,FE,BOT -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run bot:discord --prefix backend"
scripts.dev:stg: concurrently -n BE,FE,BOT -c yellow,green,magenta "npm run dev:stg --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npx tsx --cwd backend ../scripts/discord-agent-bot.ts"
scripts.prod: npx tsx scripts/prod-guard.ts "start PRODUCTION servers" && concurrently -n BE,FE,BOT -c red,green,magenta "npm run dev:prod --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npx tsx scripts/discord-agent-bot.ts"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push:local --prefix backend && npm run seed:local --prefix backend
scripts.db:setup:stg: npm run db:push:stg --prefix backend && npm run seed:stg --prefix backend
